_doc: Render tiers. Frame rate (30 fps) and motion-blur shutter (0.5) are set by the style spec at C1 (config/look.json); motion_blur_steps is how many times Eevee re-evaluates the scene inside the shutter. Iteration moved from the GTX 970 box to the RTX 5090 box on 2026-10-25 (human), still at 720p; draft720 samples and steps were picked there by scripts/qc_mbtest.py (8 samples left crawling grain in soft shadows).
